propositions: Core must compare only canonical (local-vocabulary) shapes; vendor shapes cross the port solely as opaque payloads at emission and ingestion boundaries
All transport construction and provider literals must route through the backend port abstraction, with no direct vendor module imports in package-root reconciler core
The outbound differ must canonicalize fetched snapshots via InboundMapper and build vendor payloads exclusively through the injected OutboundMapper at emission
Eight Jira vendor modules (acli, adf, outbound_fields, comment_limits, etc.) must be physically relocated into adapters/jira/ with no re-export shims or reach-through in core
Scalar port surface must be pinned with project/query_project, assert_env_ready, and neutral BackendAssigneeNotFoundError, wiring through fetcher, applier, and apply_handlers
